correctness.rationale: Folded odd n-cube is F2^n/<1> with n generator images. A closed n-cycle homomorphism has n increments, whose mod2 occurrence vector is 0 or all1; odd n forces all1 and exactly one use of each generator. Hence vertex maps count N=2^{n-1}n!. Common neighbors of endpoints of a length-two segment are exactly the two intermediate vertices for n>=5 odd because the unique n-term relation cannot occur in a <=4-term even parity sum. At each source position the alternative swaps consecutive labels. Two simultaneous adjacent changes violate complete-bipartite Hom adjacency; independent position sets give all and only cubes, so vertex links are exactly Ind(C_n). As independence complexes are flag, Gromov link criterion gives local CAT(0) cube complex, and full universal cover contractible. Adjacent swaps generate permutations at fixed root, and root changes by pair-generator sums spanning V_n, yielding connectivity. Double-count cube/vertex incidences using cycle independent d-set count n/(n-d)*binom(n-d,d), obtaining f_d=N*count/2^d and chi=N M_n(-1/2)=2^{n/2}n!cos(n pi/4). Independent exact count n=5,7,9 confirmed f_7=(322560,1128960,1128960,282240), chi_7=40320. For n=7 link Ind(C7) collapses to a circle and is not a 2-sphere/ball; for odd n>=9 link has maximal independent sets of sizes floor(n/2) and ceil(n/3), hence nonpure and cannot be manifold link. No Betti or pi1 classification claimed.

originality.rationale: Square-free-codomain graph-Hom classification by Fujii–Kimura–Nozaki and Matsushita is inapplicable because F_n contains 4-cycles, while the present homomorphism complex is multidimensional NPC with explicit links. Prior isolated Clebsch (n=5) analysis does not yield an all-odd-n theorem. Search across cube complexes, Hom functors and folded cube invariants did not identify a covering stronger theorem.
